category_title: Students with autism exhibiting sensory-maintained skin scratching
scenario_title: Math work in close proximity to peers
minimal_context: Tommy is completing his math work while seated at a table in close proximity to his peers in the mild/moderate special education classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is your math work for today. Please sit at this table next to your classmates and complete the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins completing his work and simultaneously scratches his own skin) Okay.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep going with the math problems.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am feeling nervous. Scratching feels good and helps calm me down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to finish the page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Reaches over to the student sitting next to him, grabs the peer’s hand, and uses it to scratch his own skin)
